entries.title: I Timothy 6:1
segments: ¶Let as many bondmen as are under yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and the teaching be not blasphemed.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:2
segments: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise [them] because they are brethren; but let them the rather serve them with subjection, because they are faithful and beloved, who profit by the good and ready service [rendered]. These things teach and exhort.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:3
segments: If any one teach differently, and do not accede to sound words, those of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the teaching which [is] according to piety,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:4
segments: he is puffed up, knowing nothing, but sick about questions and disputes of words, out of which arise envy, strife, injurious words, evil suspicions,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:5
segments: constant quarrellings of men corrupted in mind and destitute of the truth, holding gain to be [the end of] piety.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:6
segments: ¶But piety with contentment *is* great gain.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:7
segments: For we have brought nothing into the world: [it is] [manifest] that neither can we carry anything out.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:8
segments: But having sustenance and covering, we will be content with these.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:9
segments: But those who desire to be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and many unwise and hurtful lusts, which plunge men into destruction and ruin.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:10
segments: For the love of money is [the] root of every evil; which some having aspired after, have wandered from the faith, and pierced themselves with many sorrows.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:11
segments: But *thou*, O man of God, flee these things, and pursue righteousness, piety, faith, love, endurance, meekness of spirit.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:12
segments: Strive earnestly [in] the good conflict of faith. Lay hold of eternal life, to which thou hast been called, and hast confessed the good confession before many witnesses.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:13
segments: ¶I enjoin thee before God who preserves all things in life, and Christ Jesus who witnessed before Pontius Pilate the good confession,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:14
segments: that thou keep the commandment spotless, irreproachable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ;

entries.title: I Timothy 6:15
segments: which in its own time the blessed and only Ruler shall shew, the King of those that reign, and Lord of those that exercise lordship;

entries.title: I Timothy 6:16
segments: who only has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light; whom no man has seen, nor is able to see; to whom [be] honour and eternal might. Amen.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:17
segments: Enjoin on those rich in the present age not to be high-minded, nor to trust on the uncertainty of riches; but in the God who affords us all things richly for [our] enjoyment;

entries.title: I Timothy 6:18
segments: to do good, to be rich in good works, to be liberal in distributing, disposed to communicate [of their substance],

entries.title: I Timothy 6:19
segments: laying by for themselves a good foundation for the future, that they may lay hold of [what is] really life.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:20
segments: O Timotheus, keep the entrusted deposit, avoiding profane, vain babblings, and oppositions of false-named knowledge,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:21
segments: of which some having made profession, have missed the faith. Grace [be] with thee.
